subject: Executive recap: KPIs, compliance gating, and procurement runway
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medicore.com>, Tom Erickson <terickson@medicore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Executive recap: KPIs, compliance gating, and procurement runway

Hi Alicia & Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Below is a concise executive-level recap to make sure we’re aligned on outcomes, risks, and next steps for the proposed inference pilot. I focused this for your leadership and procurement teams.

Summary of business outcomes you highlighted
- Reduce inference latency for clinical prompts from ~700ms to <200ms (target P95) across the 1–3k token window.
- Bring per-prediction cost down by ~40% through batching + KV cache reuse for recurring templates.
- Demonstrate data residency and auditability for a 6-week pilot to validate model outputs in production.

Key risks & gating items for leadership
1) Compliance: SOC 2 evidence plus KMS integration required for pilot sign-off. You asked for an on-prem equivalent path (we support VPC/private deployments).
2) Procurement timeline: finance needs a 60-day runway from SOW acceptance for standard PO.
3) Ops readiness: a single point of contact on your side for environment prep and data mapping.

Recommended procurement path (high level)
- Week 1: Sign SOW (attached v1) and confirm pilot scope (ETA: 1 week)
- Weeks 2–4: Deployment & integration (Redwood Dedicated or VPC option)
- Weeks 5–6: Validation and success criteria review; decision on expansion or reserved capacity

Immediate asks
- Alicia: Confirm the PO cadence/owner and whether your legal can accept our standard DPA + SOW (I’ll surface SOC2 evidence in the next email).
- Tom: Please confirm the technical POC owner and the primary test dataset location.

Attachments: Medicore_MLPilot_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW draft), SOC2-Audit-Summary.pdf (summary evidence).

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medicore.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Erickson <terickson@medicore.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive recap: KPIs, compliance gating, and procurement runway

Priya — thanks for the clear recap. Two clarifications from leadership side: 

1) Procurement/PO: Finance is comfortable with a 45–60 day runway; our preferred start date is the week of July 12 to align with budget quarter close. Can Redwood hold the pilot slot?
2) Compliance: We’ll need the full SOC 2 report for legal review (not just a summary) and confirmation that key rotation can be done via our existing Azure Key Vault.

Operationally, I’m assigning Tom as the POC for the technical work and I’ll loop in procurement once you confirm SOW changes.

Appreciate the SOW draft — we’ll review and send redlines.

—Alicia
Alicia Gomez
VP, Product & Innovation | Medicore Health
alicia.gomez@medicore.com | +1 617-555-3201

Alicia / Tom —

Thanks for the quick responses and Ben for the details. Quick confirmation and next steps: 

Decisions confirmed
- Redwood will hold a provisional pilot slot for the week of July 12 pending SOW sign (we’ll hold provisioning until SOW signature or a 25% deposit).
- Redwood supports Azure Key Vault integration and will surface the full SOC 2 report to your legal via the shared Drive link (Ben will upload by EOD).

Action items
- Medicore (Alicia): Confirm PO owner and whether you prefer PO vs. deposit by June 9.
- Medicore (Tom): Share the test dataset location and a sample prompt set by June 9.
- Redwood (Ben): Upload SOC 2 and add Medicore to Drive folder; confirm key rotation docs by June 3.
- Redwood (Priya): Revise SOW v1 to reflect pilot start window and add a procurement acceptance clause; circulate redline by June 6.

If there are any executive-level blockers outside of SOC 2 + finance runway, flag them and I’ll escalate to our Commercial lead. Otherwise I’ll treat this as green to proceed toward SOW revisions.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
